newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - T-bonds rangebound for now but eye 108-30.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - T-bonds rangebound for now but eye 108-30.

text.p: June T-bond futures may rebound slightly but the overall technical picture remains negative, chart analysts said on Tuesday.
"We have got a round top formation and that is a bearish pattern," said Donna Liu, technical analyst at DKB International in London, pegging key support at 108-30.
"If the market does not break through this level today it should really rebound. But even a (slight) rebound should not damage the formation."
Support at 108-30 reflects the lows on May 8 and 22 and marks the low for the whole of May so far.
At 1035 GMT, June T-bond futures were at 109-09 in automated trade, up 3/32 from Friday's close.
LIFFE June T-bonds were at 109-08, unchanged on the day.
"A break below 108-30 gives a target of 108-12 and then 107-26," said Liu. These are the low on April 30 and the highs on April 3 and 4 respectively.
Tom Hobson, director of technical analysis at Merrill Lynch in London, said the market's rangebound tone had blurred the short term direction. But the bias was slightly to the downside.
"This is simply because last week after pretty positive fundamental information the market was unable to secure any closes above key resistance which to me is around the 110-12 area," he said.
T-bonds failed to extend their rally last week despite the U.S. Federal Reserve's decision on Tuesday to hold interest rates steady.
Hobson pegged support initially at 109-09 which represented the 38.2 pct retracement of the last rally, followed by 108-30.
But more crucial support came in at 108-08, he said. This level was formed within the former high in March when the market was consolidating.
"I don't see 108-08 failing. But I think there is potential for 108-30 to be violated," Hobson said.
He pegged resistance at 109-24, followed by 110-12 and 112-20.
Liu said a rebound could take the contract to initial resistance at 109-12. That level was the high on May 22.
"Only if the market gets above 110-14 will it be different. Overall we still remain negative, we are still in a sixth month of down channel," she said.
At the short end September Eurodollars were at 93.970, unchanged on the day.
